evidence: Lighthouse: "Image elements do not have [alt] attributes"
user_impact: Screen reader users cannot understand the purpose or content of the image
recommended_fix: Add descriptive alt text to the image (use alt="" if purely decorative)

evidence: Lighthouse: "Links do not have a discernible name"
user_impact: Screen reader and keyboard users cannot determine the destination or purpose of the link
recommended_fix: Add visible link text or an aria-label describing the link's purpose

evidence: Lighthouse: "Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio"
user_impact: Low-vision users may find it difficult or impossible to read the text
recommended_fix: Increase the contrast ratio between text and background to at least 4.5:1

evidence: Lighthouse: "Lists do not contain only <li> elements and script supporting elements"
user_impact: Screen readers may not announce the list structure correctly, confusing navigation
recommended_fix: Ensure lists contain only li elements as direct children, move other elements outside

evidence: Lighthouse: "Touch targets do not have sufficient size or spacing"
user_impact: Users with motor impairments or on mobile devices may struggle to tap small links accurately
recommended_fix: Increase the clickable area of the link to at least 24x24 pixels
